justification: Pure bounded in-memory composition over existing validated and audited OAuth, HTTP/1, and HTTPS-destination evidence. It invokes only a caller-injected provider/trace audit sink before credential-bearing reads and before releasing prepared wipe-on-drop request bytes. It directly performs no filesystem, network, process, environment, clock, FFI, credential acquisition or edit, signing, TLS, HTTP I/O, socket, or transport effect.
